user.title: Terrazzo
user.description: Adds a Terrazzo dashboard to the sidebar at /terrazzo. It draws your Lovelace dashboards and signs in as whoever opens it.

data_description.title: The name of the panel in the sidebar.
data_description.dashboard: Leave empty to start on the dashboard picker. Any dashboard can still be opened from the panel, or bookmarked as /terrazzo?dashboard=<url path>.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Terrazzo is already set up. Use Configure to change it.

data_description.title: The name of the panel in the sidebar.
data_description.dashboard: Leave empty to start on the dashboard picker.
data_description.mcp_user: Off, or the one Home Assistant user an AI assistant may act as through /api/terrazzo/mcp, with that user's permissions on this instance only. Only that user's access tokens are accepted. Locks and alarm panels stay read-only.

yaml_overrides_ui.title: Terrazzo is configured in YAML
yaml_overrides_ui.description: Terrazzo's `terrazzo:` block in configuration.yaml is applied again on every start, so it replaces changes made under Settings → Devices & services. Your settings are already in the integration: remove the `terrazzo:` block and restart to manage Terrazzo from the UI.

web_origin.title: Allow Terrazzo at {origin} to load images

confirm.title: Allow {origin}?
confirm.description:
Terrazzo at {origin} is signed in to Home Assistant, but Home Assistant blocks it from loading camera and entity pictures. Allowing it adds {origin} to Home Assistant's allowed CORS origins, then restarts Home Assistant. Terrazzo confirms the change once Home Assistant is back; if it doesn't start, Home Assistant reverts it after five minutes.

Only allow a site you installed Terrazzo on yourself.

abort.unsupported: This Home Assistant keeps its HTTP settings in configuration.yaml. Add {origin} under `http:` → `cors_allowed_origins` and restart.
abort.not_running: Home Assistant is still starting. Try again once it has finished.
abort.pending_change: Another HTTP settings change is waiting to be confirmed. Confirm or discard it first.
